style: Epic painterly fantasy card illustration, highly detailed, cinematic composition, dramatic rim lighting and deep shadows, rich cosmic colour.
race: The Aureline, exactly as in the reference images: tall, slender, solemn beings with smooth pale grey alien skin, an elongated smooth bald head with one single large cyclopean eye that holds a starfield, a narrow lipless face, long thin fingers, a glowing golden halo ring floating around the head or neck, flowing ivory-white robes or gold-trimmed white-and-gold plate armour with fine gold embroidery. They carry sun-staffs (a twisted golden staff cradling a small blazing sun in a cage of golden rings) or sun-lances (long white-and-gold lances tipped with a leaf-shaped blade of solid golden light). Every Aureline is an individual: vary build, height, head shape, eye colour, robes, armour and markings. They are never human: no human faces, no noses, no hair or beards, never two eyes; even the old, the huge and the heavily armoured are unmistakably Aureline. Every single figure in the picture, background crowds and companions included, is an Aureline: there are no humans anywhere.
framing: Wide 16:9 landscape. The painted scene fills the whole picture edge to edge: its sky or background continues right up to the top edge, with open sky across the top quarter (never a flat colour band, blank strip, letterbox bar, border or frame). The main figure's head sits about 40% of the way down and a little to one side of centre, never at the very top; keep faces and key details away from the bottom centre of the picture. The painting runs right to the bottom edge with no emblem, seal, logo, line or border anywhere. No text, no lettering.

cards.helio_lancer: Aureline Lancer, in battle. An Aureline lancer in white-and-gold plate armour and a crimson cape lunges from the left across a scorched, burning plain at dusk, driving a sun-lance into the glowing core of a Xel'Naru warrior: a hulking figure built of hovering rose-pink crystal shards around a core of white light. Crystal shards and golden sparks burst from the impact. Smoke columns and distant fires on the horizon, a low orange sun behind, other lancers and crystal warriors clashing far off in the haze.
cards.ignition_protocol: Sol-Marshal Aurex, the Aureline war-marshal, leaps from the prow of a charging Aureline sun-barque (a sleek ship of white metal and gold carrying a captive blazing sun between two tall pylons) down toward a burning enemy world below. Aurex, in ornate gold armour with a sunburst crown and a streaming red cape, has a sun-lance levelled for the strike. Behind him the barque's engines flare; around him streaks of fire, enemy beams lancing up from the planet, debris and other barques diving in formation.
cards.aureline_sun_priest: The Aureline Sun-Priest at worship. A robed Aureline priest in ivory and gold, with a red stole, stands at the top of a great white stone stair, sun-staff raised high toward an enormous rising sun that fills the sky. Rows of kneeling Aureline faithful in white robes line the steps below, heads bowed, their halos glowing. Shafts of golden light pour down the stair through incense smoke, between colossal temple columns.
cards.halo_ward: A Halo Warden protecting a Stellari bloom. On a dead, ruined grey world under a dark starry sky with a pale moon, an Aureline warden in pale blue-and-silver armour kneels over a single luminous white flower (the Stellari: twelve long translucent petals glowing from within) growing from the cracked ground among broken columns. The warden holds up a round shield of blue hard light, and a dome of shimmering light arches over the flower as falling crystal shards shatter against it.
cards.aurelia_first_light: Aurelia, the First Light, the first Aureline, at the dawn of time. A tall, ancient and serene Aureline in radiant white robes, a delicate golden circlet and a brilliant golden halo, cradles the Infinite Stellari (a great white flower of long glowing translucent petals) in her long-fingered hands. Its light is the first light in the universe and pours out across a newborn cosmos: swirling nebulae, young stars igniting, galaxies forming behind her. Reverent, quiet, awe-inspiring.
cards.command_directive: Solarch Veyra, an Aureline war-leader, stands on the bridge of her flagship issuing commands in the middle of a fleet battle. A tall, sharp-featured Aureline woman with a swept-back crested head, an amber cyclopean eye and a high collar of gold plate, one long arm flung forward to point the attack. Holographic sun-charts glow on a curved white-and-gold console beside her; through the vast window behind her, golden Aureline sun-barques wheel into formation against a crimson nebula, beams crossing the dark.
cards.sunspear: Sunspear, the throw that ends a battle. A lean, scarred Aureline spearman in battered white-and-gold half-plate, braced on one knee on a shattered rock spire, has just hurled a spear of pure blazing sunfire. It streaks across the frame and punches clean through the dark armoured hull of a Vorthane leviathan-ship (a vast ocean-dark vessel of barnacled plates and glowing sea-green vents), white fire bursting out of the far side. The spear's backwash scorches the thrower's cloak and the rock around him; embers and molten fragments everywhere.
cards.aureline_war_herald: One single Aureline War-Herald (only one herald in the picture) on a high ridge at sunrise, sounding a long curved golden war-horn as the army behind it begins to march. A broad-shouldered, older Aureline (smooth bald alien head creased with age, one large pale green cyclopean eye, no nose, no beard) with a heavy red-and-gold tabard, a tall sun-banner of white silk snapping in the wind from a pole strapped to its back. Below, columns of Aureline lancers (all Aureline: bald, single-eyed, haloed) and sun-barques fill the valley, light glinting off a thousand lance-tips.
cards.aureline_archon: An Aureline Archon in battle: a towering, ancient warrior-lord in ornate gold plate engraved with sun-glyphs and a tall crested helm-halo, bringing a great two-handed sword of white sunfire down onto a hulking Korrath war engine (a squat, riveted iron siege-walker with furnace-red eyes and hammer arms). Sparks and molten iron fly from the cleaving blow. The Archon's single eye burns white-gold; behind, Aureline vanguard troops surge forward through smoke on a scorched plain.
cards.the_sun_throne: The Sun Throne: a vast domed hall of white stone and gold where a throne has been carved into the face of a captive miniature sun, its surface roiling with fire behind a lattice of golden rings. A young Aureline heir in simple white robes (small and slight, a smooth bald grey head with one large eye, no hair, a faint new halo), nervous, walks the long golden carpet toward it while rows of robed Aureline elders with tall staffs line the way, every one an Aureline (bald alien head, single eye, no beard), each different in build, robes and halo. Shafts of sunlight fall from the dome; motes of light drift in the air.
cards.aureline_sunguard: An Aureline Sunguard holding the line. A huge, heavyset Aureline guard (smooth pale grey alien head, one large cyclopean eye, no nose, a golden halo ring) in thick white-and-gold plate, feet planted on cracked flagstones, raises a towering shield of solid golden hard-light as a storm of Pyrr fire (roaring flame-wreathed figures of living fire and ember) breaks against it in a wall of flame. Behind the guard, a wounded Aureline soldier lies sheltering while an Aureline medic tends it (both bald grey-skinned, single-eyed, haloed: no humans). Heat shimmer, flying embers, the shield blazing where the fire strikes.
cards.dawn_beacon: A Dawn Beacon igniting: on a lonely clifftop tower above a sea of clouds, an Aureline keeper (thin, elderly, in a hooded ochre robe with a lantern at its belt) pulls a great lever as the beacon at the tower's crown blazes into a column of golden light. Far away across the clouds, answering beacons flare one after another on distant peaks. The first edge of a huge rising sun on the horizon, deep blue night still above.
cards.lancer_squadron: A Lancer Squadron diving into battle: five Aureline lancers on sleek white-and-gold sun-skiffs (narrow, winged single-rider craft trailing ribbons of gold light) plunge in a tight V formation through a battlefield sky, lances levelled. All five riders are Aureline (bald grey heads, single eyes, halos), each different: one young and grinning, one helmeted, one with a torn red pennant, one crested, one older and scarred. Below them, a Xel'Naru crystal fortress of rose-pink shards fires beams upward; flak bursts and shard fragments fill the air.
cards.aureline_vesper_knight: A Vesper Knight at dusk, fighting in a ruined colonnade as the sun sets. A lithe Aureline knight in violet-tinted silver-and-gold armour with a long trailing scarf, twin curved blades of fading orange sunlight in its hands, spins to meet Nyxari assassins lunging from the shadows (shadowy, near-invisible figures of smoke and starless black with thin violet eyes). The last red light of the sun slants through the broken columns, long shadows across the floor.
cards.prism_of_dawn: The Prism of Dawn springs its trap. In a deep canyon at dawn, a great faceted crystal prism, set in a golden frame and hidden behind rocks, catches an enemy's attack beam (a thick bolt of sickly green energy fired from a distant Ixquor hive-ship, a bulbous organic vessel with glowing pods) and splits it into a fan of brilliant rainbow lances that fly back at the attacker. An Aureline engineer with goggles pushed up on its brow and tools at its belt crouches beside the prism, shielding its eye from the glare.
cards.dawnblade: A lithe young Aureline swordswoman in close-fitting white-and-gold armour and a short crimson half-cape lunges across a cracked stone bridge above a misty gorge at sunrise, her curved sword of solid golden sunlight trailing an arc of flame as it parries the descending war-axe of a hulking Korrath warrior (a squat, heavy-shouldered brute in riveted iron plate with furnace-red eye-slits). Sparks burst where the blades meet.
cards.solar_aegis: A ring of five Aureline soldiers on a scorched hilltop raise their arms together, and a vast golden dome of interlocking hexagonal light snaps shut over them as a storm of Xel'Naru crystal shards (rose-pink, jagged, glowing) rains down and shatters against it. One soldier is tall and robed, one squat in heavy bronze plate, one young with a blue sash, one ancient and stooped, one crested and helmeted.
cards.aureline_cantor: At dusk on a temple balcony, an elderly Aureline cantor in layered violet-and-ivory robes, head tilted back with its single eye closed, sings a long note; the song becomes visible as rippling rings of soft blue-white light spreading out across a battlefield below, cooling the burning ground and the smoke into mist. A young acolyte holds a lantern beside it.
cards.halo_sentinel: A towering Aureline sentinel in massive pale-silver plate, a great halo blazing behind its helm-crest, stands alone in a narrow mountain pass with a tall kite-shaped shield of white light braced in the ground, as a pack of Nyxari shadow-assassins (near-invisible figures of smoke and starless black with thin violet eyes) hurl themselves at it from the dark and break apart against the light.
cards.helio_bastion: An Aureline fortress-tower of white stone and gold on a cliff at nightfall, its crown a great mirrored dish catching the last of the sun and sending a calm column of light down into cooling vents; a stout Aureline engineer in a leather apron and brass goggles turns a huge valve wheel on the battlements while steam curls up into the starry sky.
cards.dawn_rampart: At first light, an Aureline wall of white stone along a ridge is lined with defenders raising their sun-lances as the rising sun ignites a sheet of golden light along the whole rampart; a Vorthane leviathan (a vast ocean-dark beast-ship of barnacled plates and glowing sea-green vents) crashes against the foot of the wall in a burst of spray and light. The defenders are all different: young, old, robed, armoured, crested, one bandaged.
cards.gilded_lens: In a cluttered workshop of brass instruments and star-charts, a slender Aureline artificer with long fingers and a jeweller's loupe over its single amber eye grinds a huge golden lens on a turning wheel; a beam of sunlight from a high window passes through the lens and focuses into a tiny blazing star hovering above the bench, throwing gold patterns across the walls.
cards.radiant_hymn: A great choir of Aureline in a vast circular amphitheatre open to the night sky, every singer different in height, robes and halo, raises its voices together; above them the song becomes a slowly turning ring of golden light, and at its heart a solemn Aureline Hero in white-and-gold armour, lance grounded, listens with its head bowed.
cards.banner_of_dawn: A young Aureline standard-bearer in light ivory armour plants a huge sun-banner (white silk with a gold sunburst, rippling and torn) on the summit of a captured Ixquor hive-mound (a bulbous organic tower of glowing green pods) as the sun rises behind it; below, Aureline soldiers of every build cheer and raise their lances, the defeated hive dark and smoking.
cards.aureline_quartermaster: In a busy supply tent behind the battle lines, a stout, bustling Aureline quartermaster with a heavy ledger under one arm and spectacles perched over its single eye hands a repaired, gleaming sun-lance back to a battered young lancer; racks of lances, stacked round shields of golden light and crates of glowing sun-cells fill the tent, and the battle's glow flickers through the open flap.
cards.aureline_watchkeeper: At dusk on a lonely white watchtower above a frozen sea, an old, thin Aureline sentry in a long frost-grey cloak keeps watch, sun-lance planted; as a Xel'Naru crystal raider (a jagged figure of rose-pink shards around a white core) climbs over the parapet, the watchkeeper turns and a wave of pale blue-white cold light bursts from its lance, freezing the raider mid-leap in a shell of ice.
cards.aureline_sunset_lancer: Silhouetted against an enormous red setting sun on a ridge of black rock, a lean Aureline lancer in copper-and-ivory armour with a long dark-orange scarf waits motionless, then lunges down at a Pyrr fire-raider (a roaring figure of living flame and ember) charging up the slope, its sun-lance blazing red-gold like the last light of day.
cards.p_sunlance_cadet: A young, slight Aureline cadet in plain, slightly oversized white training armour, halo still faint and new, grips a sun-lance a little too tightly at the edge of its first battle, eye wide, while older Aureline veterans of every build stride past it toward the smoke and fire on the plain below.
cards.p_gilded_vanguard: A heavyset Aureline vanguard in ornate, gleaming gilded plate with sunburst engravings plants a broad round shield at the front of a marching column in a mountain pass, the morning sun flashing off the gold; behind, a long line of Aureline soldiers in white, ivory and deep blue follows up the switchback road.
cards.p_dawn_lancer: At the first edge of sunrise over misty grassland, an Aureline lancer on a tall, slender white-and-gold winged sun-skiff rides low and fast through the mist, lance couched, its long pale-gold pennant streaming, with the golden disc of the sun just breaking the horizon behind it.
cards.p_solar_paladin: A tall, broad Aureline paladin in thick white plate with a solar disc on its breastplate stands in the ruins of a burning Aureline shrine, holding a great two-handed hammer of white-gold light, shielding a group of fleeing Aureline pilgrims (each different: old, young, robed, carrying bundles) as Korrath iron war-walkers loom through the smoke behind.
cards.p_radiant_champion: In a golden arena under a blazing sun, an Aureline champion in shining, ceremonial white-and-gold armour with a tall crest raises a sun-lance in triumph over a defeated Vorthane gladiator (a heavy, scaled sea-creature warrior with a coral-encrusted trident), as crowds of Aureline of every kind cheer from the tiers above.
cards.aureline_solar_tithe: In a dim temple of white stone, a kneeling Aureline warrior in battered armour lays its own glowing sun-lance on a golden altar before a hovering miniature sun; the lance's light flows up into the sun in a stream of gold, and on the far wall a projected image shows an enemy war-machine dimming and failing. Robed Aureline priests watch from the shadows.
cards.aureline_dawns_judgement: At dawn on a high stone tribunal, a stern, ancient Aureline judge in flowing ivory robes and a tall golden halo raises one long-fingered hand, and a pillar of white sunlight slams down from the sky onto a Nyxari infiltrator (a shadowy figure of smoke and starless black with thin violet eyes) caught in the open below, burning the shadows away; the judge holds an open scroll in its other hand.
cards.aureline_sunbreak_rite: A circle of six robed Aureline priests, each different in robes, height and halo, stand around a great golden sun-sigil carved into a mountaintop and offer up their light together; two columns of blazing gold rise from the circle and crash down on an Ixquor hive-ship (a bulbous organic vessel covered in glowing green pods) on the horizon, splitting it open.
cards.sunforged_lens: Sunforged Lens, fused to a war machine. In a smoky Aureline field forge at night, two Aureline smiths (one tall and wiry in a scorched leather apron, one short and broad with a heavy bronze arm-guard) hold a great faceted golden lens, still glowing white-hot from the sun-furnace behind them, against the front of a battered white-and-gold siege engine; molten gold flows from the lens's rim into the engine's plating as it fuses on, and the lens already focuses a hot beam of sunlight that scorches a line across the ground ahead.

edits.glory_charge: Glory Charge: the lancer at the front charges at the head of the army, mouth open in a war-cry. Make every figure a different individual: the leader a tall, gaunt Aureline in battle-scarred gold plate with a torn white cape (not red), and the soldiers behind in varied armour, robes, capes and colours (white, ivory, gold, some deep blue or bronze), different builds, head shapes and eye colours, no two alike. Add the enemy they charge: a line of Korrath war engines (squat, riveted iron siege-walkers with furnace-red eyes) looming out of the dust at the right edge.
edits.aureline_vanguard: Aureline Vanguard: the front rank of an Aureline army braced to take a charge. The lancer in front plants its feet behind a tall round shield of golden hard-light, lance levelled over it. Make every figure a different individual: the leader a stocky, broad-headed Aureline with a bronze-tinted face, an amber eye and heavy dented bronze-and-white plate with no cape; the ranks behind in varied armour and colours (ivory, gold, deep blue, bronze), different builds, head shapes and eye colours, no two alike, shields locked. Add what they hold against: a wave of Xel'Naru crystal warriors (hulking figures of hovering rose-pink crystal shards around cores of white light) crashing into the line from the right, shards flying.
